messages:
incident-bot: page fired -> P1 KMS decrypt error spike across prod-east. Auto-escalation to eng-oncall. PagerDuty incident created.

elena (oncall): PagerDuty PD-2026-1146 just fired — seeing a sudden increase in decrypt failures (multiple services). Customers reporting failures for tokenized payloads. Anyone oncall for KMS? :rotating_light:

pagerduty-bot: Incident created: PD-2026-1146. Acknowledgement required. Current assignee: elena (oncall).

elena (oncall): Acked. quick status: logs show two error classes: ThrottlingException / RateExceeded (429) from cloud-kms, and intermittent KeyNotFound for rotated keys. Example log: `com.redwood.kms.DecryptException: ThrottlingException: Rate exceeded for key arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:...:key/abc123`

samir (sre): Noted. Are failures global or limited to us-east region?

josh (kms-owner): our metric stream shows spikes in decrypt latency and 429s originating from the us-east KMS proxy cluster. Key rotation job for onboarding service kicked at ~1769954000 — possible partial rotation left a key missing in some pods. Also seeing HSM-backed signer queue growth.

elena (oncall): Immediate mitigation plan: 1) disable rotation job, 2) toggle service-level fallback to older key cache, 3) backoff retries from clients to reduce KMS QPS. Samir, can you coordinate the patch for the rotation job? Josh, can you validate key presence in HSM?

samir (sre): On it. Patching the cronjob now to suspend.

samir (sre): `kubectl -n infra patch cronjob kms-key-rotation --type=json -p '[[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/suspend","value":true}]'`

josh (kms-owner): I'm querying HSM and KMS IAM logs. Quick check: one rotated key didn't finish replication to the secondary HSM cluster due to transient ThrottlingException from cloud provider. Starting a scoped replication job for that key.

maya (support): We have a handful of customer reports about 502s for auth endpoints. Posting status page note draft for approval.

elena (oncall): Good. Also reduce client retry storm: apply env override to services to switch to local key-cache and reduced retry aggressiveness. Patch example (service config):
```
KMS_KEY_CACHE_TTL=3600
KMS_CLIENT_MAX_RETRIES=3
KMS_BACKOFF_BASE_MS=200
```

samir (sre): Applying config override via fleet rollout (canary first). `./deploy/rollout.sh --service auth --env override.kms_retries=3`

pagerduty-bot: PD-2026-1146 acknowledged by elena (oncall). Next escalation at +12 minutes if not resolved.

samir (sre): Canary looks OK for auth. No decrypt failures in the next 2 minutes. Rolling to 25% then 100% if stable.

josh (kms-owner): Replication job to secondary HSM cluster started. Cloud KMS throttling window persists but our reduced QPS keeps calls within limits. I also created a temporary alias that points back to the previous key material until replication completes.

elena (oncall): Nice. Are there any services still reporting KeyNotFound?

samir (sre): A small portion of batch workers still hit KeyNotFound due to old cached key ids. I'll kill and restart the pods after ensuring they pick up the alias fallback.

samir (sre): `kubectl -n jobs rollout restart deployment batch-workers`

josh (kms-owner): Confirmed alias in HSM and KMS point to old key. Decrypts successful for test vectors from affected services.

maya (support): Status page updated: 'Partial authentication failures affecting a subset of customers in us-east. Mitigation in progress.' :white_check_mark:

elena (oncall): Requesting 15-minute watch. Samir, you own runbook steps for restart and rollout. Josh, keep monitoring HSM replication and cloud KMS throttle metrics. I'll keep PD updated.

samir (sre): Watch started. No new errors in the last 10 minutes. Rolling restarts completed for batch-workers.

josh (kms-owner): Throttle metrics trending down. Replication completed for the pending key at 1769955900. Verified decrypt success across canary and batch.

pagerduty-bot: PD-2026-1146 updated: Mitigation in progress. Elapsed time: 30m.

elena (oncall): Good work. I'm going to handoff to oncall-rotation for the next 2 hours to monitor while I take a break. Samir -> please escalate to me immediately if KeyNotFound or 429 resurfaces.

oncall-rotation: Taking over monitoring for next 2 hours. Will ping if anything pops.

samir (sre): Adding a temporary alert suppression window for known noisy signals to avoid duplicate PD pages while watching.

josh (kms-owner): Postmortem note: rotation job needs extra verification step to confirm replication before publishing new alias. Filing a PR to add a replication-check stage.

elena (oncall): PD: moving to monitoring. If stable for 60 minutes, we'll resolve and close.

pagerduty-bot: PD-2026-1146 resolved by elena (oncall). Resolution summary: suspended key-rotation cronjob, applied alias fallback to previous key, reduced client retry aggressiveness, restarted affected workers, replication completed to secondary HSM. Total time 41m.

elena (oncall): Closing thread here — will write full incident writeup in #incidents/postmortems and assign action items: add replication check to rotation, improve client-side exponential backoff by default, add better observability for alias propagation. Thanks all. :heart:
